stories.title: MLB Files Federal Lawsuit Against MLBPA — Seeks to Shield Lockout From Antitrust Challenge

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: MLB filed a federal lawsuit against the MLBPA in Manhattan, seeking a court ruling that a lockout doesn't violate antitrust law. Named defendants include Tarik Skubal and Paul Skenes. Union: "completely frivolous." CBA expires Dec 1. Lockout expected Dec 2. #MLB

x_posts.text: MLB didn't just prepare for a lockout — it sued for one. The league filed a federal antitrust suit naming 8 players, including Skubal and Skenes. The union says it's completely frivolous. Dec 1 deadline stands. #MLB #MLBLockout

stories.title: Skubal's $450M Mets Deal Is Official — Record Contract for Any Pitcher in Baseball History

x_posts.text: Tarik Skubal finalizes his 9-year, $450 million deal with the Mets — a new record for any pitcher in MLB history. The day after: MLB names him in its federal lawsuit against the MLBPA. What a 48 hours for the man. #Mets #MLB

x_posts.text: $450M. 9 years. No-trade clause. Deferred money into the 2040s. Tarik Skubal just became the highest-paid pitcher in baseball history — and then got named in a lawsuit. This offseason is not normal. #Mets #MLB
